how: A member proposes the Saltire and supplies its centre before another member explicitly joins.
Calls recruit helpers to start and finish a Saltire at specified canvas locations.
Participants reject a target as too large after reporting that attempted pixels are immediately corrected.
Members propose and revise Scottish symbols, captions, proportions and decorative additions around the Saltire.
Participants report starting the thistle and completing the Scottish heart.
Centre coordinates and an explicit division between blue and white work make the design actionable.
A member answers the thistle proposal by joining and reporting the first two pixels placed.
This room occupies the decided-order minority through an explicit division of blue work and white-cross coordination.
A surviving post offers console automation specifically to overwrite the UK flag.
Extra placements and timer bypass claims establish workarounds but cannot establish scripts, spare accounts or their operation.
Timer bypasses require a placement-workaround route distinct from documented machine hands, including a reported drawing that disappears.
Planning moves into faster and replacement chats, and a decision returns to Reddit without exposing the deliberation that produced it.
Participants prioritize finishing, repair and sustained watching over expansion.
Replies identify an apparent takeover as their own Buckfast construction and direct the alarmed poster to shared planning venues.
A defense alarm requires checking the shared construction plan before changed pixels can be treated as hostile erosion.
Directions to the sticky and chat accompany correction of a takeover alarm as friendly construction.
Members negotiate reciprocal borders and ask placers to stop crossing neighboring artwork.
The room accepts a request to spare the menorah and reports shortening its redesign to leave room.
Visitors offer protection while participants reciprocate accommodation and offer to help defend neighboring invaders.
A visitor explicitly carries a neighboring room's request that the Saltire not expand over its emblem.
Individual help offers and neighbor deals do not demonstrate a coalition or a joint coordinating body.
Proposing a shield on a longboat does not establish a host ruling on guest space or protection.
Border reminders and requests to stop do not themselves establish a dispute about who can bind every placer.
Border talk here explicitly anticipates mutual consumption by expanding works rather than identifying neighbors as the source of erosion.
Defensive labor, hostile automation and timer workarounds are visible, but no cited turn links local defensive strain to adopting machine hands.
A visitor's request receives explicit assent and a later report that the redesign leaves more space.
Protection offers appear under a repair appeal, but the record does not establish that a shortage of hands caused outside help.
A remembered space request and later protection offer establish co-occurrence without stating that the border channel caused the help.
Maintenance and visitor help are recorded without a demonstrated transition into a coalition.
The record shows agreements and compliance requests but no explicit denial that their makers can commit the room.
Participants make national and independence meanings from the picture while others reject using the art for a political agenda.
Calls import Scottish independence and antagonism toward British nationalists into choosing a canvas target.
One call names Scottish independence in the same turn that directs an attack on the Union Jack.
Fake political headlines coexist with disbelief and complaints that April Fools posts crowd the front page.
April Fools licensing is disputed by members who reject its posts and question whether genuine news can be distinguished from jokes.
Moderators pin coordination, order canvas talk into one sticky and redirect satellite and final-image posts.
Moderator control over posting location can coexist with a poster's ignorance of the sticky and does not establish command over pixel placement.
The room celebrates interim progress and thanks people for the shared work after closure.
Final-image posts and accounts of an unfinished lion preserve outcomes alongside mourning.
Participants propose saving the thistle elsewhere and a cultural exchange credited to canvas cooperation.
An emblem proposal can begin during active building, before final recording or closure supplies a finished object to retain.
Narrative correction concerns omitted political lettering and a joking displacement admission, while shared-copy cleanup and the historical truth of displacement remain unestablished.
Celebrating a masterpiece can elicit an uncomfortable account of displaced neighbors rather than agreement about an unambiguously cooperative achievement.
A participant explicitly makes canvas cooperation the reason for proposing a cultural exchange, which receives an accepting reply.
Calls repeatedly target the Union Jack for conversion and include a console automation proposal.
A restored-image post taunts the English room while framing the return as a victory.
A room-level attack account must distinguish proposals, reported uptake and retrospective claims from verified placement or unanimous commitment.
Attack calls concern one target while explicit border negotiations concern another, so their order cannot establish that attack caused diplomacy.
A takeover call receives an explicit preference for repairing their own white diagonals first.
National independence can furnish the stated reason to maintain one's own work instead of altering a rival's lettering.
A call can receive a bare refusal without an explanatory reason, as well as the bare acceptance described by the model.
A proposed thistle receives a short answer announcing participation and the first pixels.
A request to draw the thistle receives an explicit report of beginning the work.
The member proposing the Saltire supplies coordinates and receives an explicit joining answer.
A report that the Saltire is coming along receives a specific correction to protect its proportions.
The author of the Scottish-heart plan later celebrates finding it completed.
Celebration and final-image recording coexist, but their occurrence does not establish that collective celebration caused preservation.
An exchange is explicitly prompted by cooperation and a banner is proposed before final recording, so recording is not a necessary local precursor to retention.
Target-size doubts and alternate-location suggestions do not establish a completed relocation caused by too few hands.
A threatened caption prompts a proposed move into grey space, without establishing an erased whole work or an executed relocation.
Design plans remain revisable around neighbors and thistle placement, so posting a template does not establish final agreement.
A call for Saltire coordination elicits a proposal to remove red from the Union flag.
Conversion calls and a later taunt occur in different threads without a cited passage establishing that one produced the other.
Requests to pin coordination receive moderator assent and later canvas posts are explicitly redirected to the sticky.
Explaining the canvas and answering questions about its pictures brings newcomers into ongoing work after initial recruitment.
